subject: Stepped latency event — hosted API regional impact & mitigations
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@meridian.ai>
Cc: Meridian AI Support <ops@meridian.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stepped latency event — hosted API regional impact & mitigations

Hi Tom,

Wanted to reach out proactively: we detected a stepped increase in P95/P99 latency affecting the hosted text-generation API in the us-west region this morning. We have opened an incident on our status page (link below) and are actively mitigating.

What you should know right now:
- Scope: a subset of requests routed to us-west experienced intermittent p95/p99 increases starting ~08:40 PST; p50 remained stable.
- User impact: some conversational sessions in Meridian's test cluster observed delayed responses (multi-second tails) and rare partial responses that required retries.
- Mitigation so far: automated fallback routing to us-east and temporary conservative batching limits applied to affected pools. This reduced the tail for most traffic by ~70%.

Status page: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-11-01-stepped-latency
Incident timeline (attached): incident_timeline.csv

I'm copying our CS on this thread; we'll keep you updated with significant changes and a postmortem once we have a root cause and remediation timeline.

Apologies for the disruption — please reply if you'd like a quick call to walk through the mitigations.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
~ Attachments: statuspage_snapshot.png (image/png)
From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@meridian.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:33:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Stepped latency event — hosted API regional impact & mitigations

Thanks Ben — appreciate the heads up. Two quick questions for our ops team:

1) Do you have an estimate for how long the fallback to us-east will remain in place? Our sessions have location affinity and we'd like to understand any session-level effects.
2) If Meridian saw retries during the window, will those be counted twice for billing? We need to prepare our internal chargeback accounting.

Also — can you confirm whether any data from our requests were logged to new S3 buckets or exported as part of debugging? Security team wants that detail.

If easier, happy to hop on a quick call — I can be available at 10:30 PT.

—Tom
Tom Evans
SRE Lead, Meridian AI
tom.evans@meridian.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:40:50 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Stepped latency event — hosted API regional impact & mitigations

Monica/Laura — forwarding Meridian's questions; they want: fallback duration estimate, billing guidance for retries, and confirmation re: any additional logging/export during debugging.

Quick notes from the ops bridge (summary):
- Fallback to us-east is active and will stay until p99 tails stabilize for three consecutive 15-minute windows; tentative ETA 2–4 hours depending on kernel rollout.
- Retries: by default retries at the client level are treated as separate requests; our internal billing rules exclude automated infrastructure-initiated duplicate tokens in charge calculations when we detect replay from our routing fallback — we should confirm if the accounting team will apply an ad-hoc credit for Meridian if their retries were outside of our automatic replay-dedup window.
- Logging/export: Debugging included temporary capture of sampling traces and a small number of request payloads to an internal debugging S3 bucket (access-controlled, audited). No bulk exports; logging was scoped to the affected request IDs.

Action items:
- Monica: confirm precise billing treatment and whether a manual credit is appropriate (assign to billing ops).
- Laura: prepare a short security note that we can share with Meridian's security team describing what was logged, retention, and access controls.

I'll keep them updated; please reply with the two items so I can close the loop.

Ben

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stepped latency event — hosted API regional impact & mitigations

Hi Tom — quick follow-up from our internal wrap and postmortem draft. Thanks for your patience.

Answers to your questions:
- Fallback duration: We kept fallback routing enabled for ~3.5 hours. We only rebalanced traffic after p99 latency stabilized across three consecutive 15-minute windows; we recorded the timeline in the attached incident_timeline.csv.
- Billing for retries: Our billing team verified that automatically-detected duplicate/replay requests from our routing fallback were excluded from invoices. For any client-initiated retries (e.g., retries you triggered from your side), those count as requests — we are offering a one-time goodwill credit for Meridian equivalent to the token cost of client-initiated retries during the incident window. If you'd like, we can follow up with a precise credit calculation.
- Logging/export: During debugging we sampled traces and captured a limited set of request IDs and payloads to an internal, access-controlled S3 debugging bucket. Access is audited and limited to the on-call engineering group; retention for these captures is 30 days. No data was exported to third parties. Laura attached a short security summary for your team (see postmortem-draft.md).

Next steps:
- We'll publish a short postmortem to the status page by EOD tomorrow including root cause (we believe a combination of kernel scheduling regressions + an inefficient batching path under a specific request shape), mitigation steps taken, and actions to prevent recurrence (kernel patch, telemetry improvements, and refined batching heuristics).
- If you'd like the credit calculation, tell me the HubSpot account or customer ID and I'll route it to billing.

Sorry again for the disruption and thanks for the quick coordination — let me know if you want a 30-min call to review the postmortem once it's published.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Reliability (On-call), Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference
~ Attachments: postmortem-draft.md (text/markdown)
